rationale: Lokesh brings production ML engineering expertise in Python-based data pipelines and forecasting systems, while Phan develops statistical learning methods and R packages for advanced modeling—complementary skill sets that could spark valuable cross-pollination between applied engineering and research. Both work at the intersection of machine learning and domain-specific problems (supply chain optimization vs. statistical research), making them well-positioned to discuss bridging practical implementation with rigorous statistical foundations.
intro_message: Lokesh kank, meet Phan Nguyen — you're coming at machine learning from different angles (production Python pipelines vs. statistical research in R), and there's real potential to learn from each other's approach to complex modeling problems.
